title: Specify CLI phase 1 verbs in Gherkin (features/cli)
description: Write the executable Gherkin specs for the five phase-1 verbs under features/cli/ (sources, sessions, show, doctor, snapshot) before any implementation: observable behavior only — output modes, exit codes, filters, snapshot safety. See them fail first. Embeds them in a new spec chapter (src/spec) to satisfy the docs-coverage guardrail.
